I haven’t been able to use the chandelier even for a single day since purchase—it never worked!
It’s convenient to dismiss it as a wiring issue, but multiple experts and repair technicians have confirmed that the real problem lies with the driver. Instead of addressing that, you kept handing me a cheap 1-foot LED strip, which costs next to nothing compared to the driver.

You must also understand that your customers don’t all live around Lohar Chawl. People travel from across MMR and even outside to buy from there. I live in Thane, and it takes considerable effort to bring the chandelier all the way to your shop—something I’ve already done twice. Each time, you kept me waiting for 2 hours before giving a temporary “solution.” It ruins the entire day.

As for my reviews, I will continue to share my experience because I don’t want others to waste their hard-earned money on a defective product that brings nothing but financial, physical, and mental stress !!
